messages:
hana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — TL;DR: recurring pattern where mid-size rollouts (>=25% traffic) + large batch configs spike tail latency and lead to manual rollback delays. Link: https://pm.internal/postmortem/2242 :mag_right:

mike: I can take the auto-rollback policy design. Proposal: two triggers (1) error_rate >= 0.8% sustained for 3m, OR (2) p95 latency > 2s for 5m. If triggered, immediate rollback to previous stable variant and an alert to oncall. Will draft the rollout-controller PR and unit tests. ETA: EOD Thu. :+1:

alice: I'll own blast-radius/flag defaults and gating. Suggested defaults: initial cohort <=1% traffic, steps of max 10%, 30m observation window between steps, require success signal from both infra and product metrics to proceed. Also add a short-circuit 'quarantine' toggle on the flag for global kill. Taking this for next Wed.

sara: I'm on runbook/playbook updates. I'll add a clear remediation checklist, sample Slack runbook messages, and a test harness for simulating the two auto-rollback triggers. I'll also add an example `flag.json` with gating metadata so SEs can reuse. ETA: Fri.

ryan: I'll add recurrence detection (monthly pattern detector) to Console alerts — if similar incident signature repeats 2x within 60d, auto-create a follow-up ticket and tag owners. Also will add a per-model small-batch recommendation engine (batch size caps based on seq length distribution). ETA: next sprint.

deploy-bot: Scheduled dry-run: canary-policy smoke test at 2242009000 (will deploy a canary to staging and run the failure-injection scenario).

hana: Nice. I'll own the tracking doc and make these action items visible in the postmortem tracker + weekly followups. Final consolidated action list (owners + due dates):
- [ ] Auto-rollback policy PR (mike) — due: Thu EOD (2242008600)
- [ ] Feature-flag defaults + gating (alice) — due: next Wed (2242612000)
- [ ] Runbook + failure harness (sara) — due: Fri (2242009200)
- [ ] Recurrence detector + dashboards (ryan) — due: sprint end (2243210000)
- [ ] Dry-run verification & report (hana + deploy-bot) — scheduled: 2242009000, report due: 2242009300

hana: Quick asks before we close: please add a 1-line status in the tracker when you open your PR/ticket (helps the weekly cadence). Also think about read-only safelists for a small set of high-risk feature flags (prod-only ~ops-personnel can unflag).

mike: will put the PR link in tracker, including a config example. For rollback thresholds we're using conservative numbers initially; we can relax after 2 successful weeks.

alice: agree re: ops-only safelist. I'll add a short approval flow for that in the docs.

sara: adding sample Slack messages and marker reactions in the runbook (:rotating_light: for escalation).

ryan: Tagging platform-owners for visibility: @mike @alice @sara — will sync with infra next Tues to ensure controller integration tests pass.

hana: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short weekly checkpoint invite. :calendar: 

(aside) hana: note to self — schedule a 60d review slot to verify recurrence detector output and whether defaults need to tighten.
